title: Enclosure Airflow Testing
objective: Check enclosure airflow, heat build-up, and vent placement for a safe enclosure revision.
hypothesis: A small vent and fan path will reduce hotspots without increasing noise too much.
test_plan: Measure temperature at several points, compare still-air vs vented runs, and record the observed delta.
setup_notes: Initial enclosure CAD notes and thermal probe layout are ready for the first run.
lesson_learned: Vent placement should be tested before final enclosure lock-in.
